projects.name: Customer Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
Analytics dashboard project covering three data domains: (1) customer data processed from CSV file exports, (2) application log analysis for operational and product signals, and (3) visualization components and dashboard views. Deliverable is a deployed dashboard enabling customer segmentation, usage/cohort insight, and application health monitoring. Structure is organized as milestones with small, independently executable tasks capped at moderate complexity.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, csv-ingestion, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: M1: Customer CSV Data Processing Pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone covering ingestion, validation, cleaning, and modeling of customer data sourced from CSV exports. Exit criteria: raw CSV files land reliably, are validated and normalized, and are queryable in a modeled customer table ready for dashboard consumption.

tasks.name: M2: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone covering parsing, normalization, and aggregation of application log data into operational and product metrics. Exit criteria: log formats documented, logs parsed into structured events, and aggregated metrics (errors, latency, activity) queryable for dashboard use.

tasks.name: M3: Visualization Components and Dashboard Views
tasks.details: Milestone covering dashboard information architecture, a reusable chart component library, and the assembled customer and application-health views. Exit criteria: dashboard renders live data across all agreed KPIs with filtering and navigation working end to end.

tasks.name: M4: Platform Foundation, API and Delivery
tasks.details: Milestone covering shared technical foundation: repository and environment scaffolding, the query/API layer serving data to the frontend, access control, testing and CI, and deployment with observability. Exit criteria: the dashboard is deployed to an environment with automated checks, authentication, and monitoring in place.

tasks.name: Repository and environment scaffolding
tasks.details: Create the monorepo layout (ingestion, api, web packages), baseline tooling (lint/format/typecheck), local dev compose file for database and services, environment variable handling with .env.example, and a README with run instructions. No business logic. Done when a new developer can clone, install, and start the stack locally with one documented command.

tasks.name: Inventory customer CSV sources and profile schemas
tasks.details: Enumerate every customer CSV export the dashboard must consume. For each: owner, delivery mechanism, refresh cadence, row volume, column list, data types, null rates, and sample values. Produce a written source inventory plus a schema profile table. Done when all sources are documented and ambiguities (duplicate exports, retired feeds) are resolved with the data owner.

tasks.name: Audit application log sources and formats
tasks.details: Identify all application log streams (app servers, workers, gateway, audit). For each: emitter, transport, storage location, retention today, volume per day, format (JSON lines, plaintext, multiline stack traces), and timezone/locale conventions. Produce a format audit document with real sample records. Done when every stream feeding the dashboard has a documented format and a named owner.

tasks.name: Define KPI inventory and dashboard information architecture
tasks.details: Workshop with stakeholders to agree the metric definitions per audience (customer success, product, engineering), then map them to screens, sections, and chart types. Deliver a KPI sheet (name, definition, formula, grain, target audience) and a low-fidelity page map. Done when each KPI has one agreed definition and every KPI is assigned to a specific dashboard section.

tasks.name: Provision data store and design shared schema
tasks.details: Stand up the analytical database (local and dev instances) and design the schema layers: raw/bronze landing tables, cleaned/silver tables, and serving/gold marts. Define naming conventions, partitioning keys, and timezone handling. Deliver migration files under version control. Done when migrations apply cleanly from scratch and the layer conventions are documented.

tasks.name: Implement authentication and role-based access control
tasks.details: Add SSO/OIDC login to the web app, session handling, and a minimal role model (viewer, analyst, admin). Enforce roles on API routes and hide unauthorized UI sections. Include a documented local dev bypass for testing. Done when an unauthenticated request is rejected and role restrictions are covered by an automated test.

tasks.name: Set up test strategy and CI pipeline
tasks.details: Agree the test pyramid for this project (unit for transforms, contract tests for data schemas, smoke tests for API and UI). Create a CI workflow that runs lint, typecheck, unit tests, and schema contract checks on every pull request, with required status checks on main. Done when CI is green on a sample PR and blocks merges on failure.

tasks.name: Write CSV validation rules and data contract
tasks.details: Translate the schema profile into an enforceable contract: required columns, types, allowed value sets, nullability, key uniqueness, row-count expectations, and date/timezone normalization rules. Specify reject-vs-quarantine behavior per rule and the quarantine table format. Done when each rule is expressed as a testable assertion with a failing-sample fixture.

tasks.name: Define log parsing spec and normalized event schema
tasks.details: Write per-format parsing rules (regex or JSON field mapping), including multiline stack-trace reassembly and timestamp normalization to UTC. Define the canonical event schema: timestamp, service, environment, severity, event_type, message, trace_id, user_id (nullable), latency_ms (nullable), and error fingerprint. Done when a golden-file test set of real samples parses into the schema with documented handling for unmatched lines.

tasks.name: Scaffold frontend app with design tokens and layout shell
tasks.details: Create the web application skeleton: routing, page layout shell with header/sidebar, theming tokens (color, spacing, typography, chart palette), loading/empty/error state primitives, and a mock data adapter so views can be built before the API exists. Done when the shell renders a placeholder page and tokens are consumed from one central file.

tasks.name: Build CSV parsing and ingestion job
tasks.details: Implement the ingestion job that reads customer CSV files, applies the data contract, writes valid rows to bronze/silver tables, and routes invalid rows to quarantine with failure reasons. Handle encoding variations, delimiter detection, and idempotent re-runs keyed on file checksum. Done when a full historical load plus a repeat run produces no duplicates and a quarantine report.

tasks.name: Implement log ingestion and event extraction
tasks.details: Implement the collector that reads each log stream, applies the parsing spec, and writes normalized events into the log event table with a parse-error side table for unmatched lines. Support backfill from archived files and checkpointed streaming reads so restarts do not duplicate events. Done when backfill of 7 days of logs completes with a parse success rate reported per stream.

tasks.name: Build reusable chart component library
tasks.details: Implement a small set of parameterized, presentational chart components covering the chart types chosen in the page map (time series, bar, stacked bar, donut/share, KPI stat tile, data table with sorting). Each accepts a typed data prop, handles loading/empty/error states, and has a usage example plus a snapshot test. Done when the library storybook or demo page shows every component with sample data.

tasks.name: Implement query API layer with typed endpoints
tasks.details: Build read-only API endpoints over the serving marts: KPI summaries, time series, segment breakdowns, and log-health metrics. Add request validation, pagination, caching headers, consistent response envelopes, and a documented OpenAPI spec. Include query cost guardrails (date-range limits, row caps). Done when endpoints return schema-valid payloads against seeded data and the spec is published.

tasks.name: Build cleaning, deduplication and identity resolution logic
tasks.details: Implement deterministic transforms: trim/normalize text, standardize country/region and currency codes, parse and unify dates to UTC, coerce numeric fields, and collapse duplicate customer records using email plus external_id matching rules. Emit a reconciliation report of merged and rejected records. Done when the cleaned table has one row per resolved customer and merge decisions are auditable.

tasks.name: Add incremental ingestion scheduling and failure handling
tasks.details: Schedule the CSV job on the documented refresh cadence, with file-arrival detection, overlap locking, retry with backoff, alerting on repeated failure, and a run-history log. Add a manual replay command for a specific file or date range. Done when a simulated failed run retries, alerts, and can be replayed without duplicating data.

tasks.name: Build error, latency and activity metric aggregations
tasks.details: Create scheduled aggregation jobs producing hourly and daily rollups: error counts by service and fingerprint, p50/p95/p99 latency from latency-bearing events, request volume, and active-user activity derived from log user_id. Ensure aggregations are recomputable for a date range. Done when rollups reconcile to raw event counts within a documented tolerance.

tasks.name: Define retention, partitioning and storage cost policy
tasks.details: Set retention windows per data tier (raw events, rollups, quarantine), define partitioning and archival/downsampling strategy, and estimate monthly storage cost at projected volume. Implement the retention job and document the policy. Done when expired partitions are dropped or archived automatically and cost estimate is reviewed with the owner.

tasks.name: Model customer dimension and segment marts
tasks.details: Build the serving-layer customer model: a customer dimension (attributes, status, signup date, plan) and segment aggregates (by plan, region, lifecycle stage, and signup cohort). Add surrogate keys, slowly-changing-dimension handling for plan/status changes, and data-freshness metadata. Done when dashboard queries for segment counts and cohort sizes return results matching a hand-verified sample.

tasks.name: Build application health dashboard views
tasks.details: Compose the log-driven screens using the chart library and live API: error trend and top fingerprints, latency percentile trend, throughput/volume, and service status summary. Wire date-range and service filters, drill-down from an error bucket to a sample event list, and correct empty/partial-data messaging. Done when each health KPI matches the aggregation tables for a spot-checked date range.

tasks.name: Configure deployment environments and observability
tasks.details: Define staging and production environments with infrastructure-as-code, a release pipeline triggered from main, health checks, structured application logs, and dashboards/alerts for API error rate, latency, and pipeline freshness. Include rollback steps in the release doc. Done when a release deploys to staging automatically and a deliberately failing job raises an alert.

tasks.name: Build customer analytics dashboard views
tasks.details: Compose the customer-facing screens using the chart library and live API: customer totals and growth trend, segment and plan breakdowns, cohort retention grid, and a searchable customer table with drill-down detail panel. Wire filters (date range, plan, region) and export to CSV for the table. Done when each customer KPI matches the segment marts for a spot-checked period.

tasks.name: Write data dictionary, runbook and handover docs
tasks.details: Document every table and metric definition, pipeline schedules and owners, on-call runbook for failed ingestions and stale data, environment access steps, and known limitations. Include a short onboarding guide for analysts. Done when a teammate unfamiliar with the project can diagnose a failed pipeline run using only the runbook.

tasks.name: Assemble dashboard with global filters and navigation
tasks.details: Integrate the customer and health views into one navigation structure with a shared global filter bar (date range, plan, region, service) persisted in the URL. Add a landing overview page combining top KPIs, cross-links between views, saved-view support, and consistent refresh/freshness indicators. Done when filters apply across all views and a deep link reproduces the same dashboard state.

tasks.name: Complete accessibility and responsive layout QA
tasks.details: Test the finished dashboard at mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints. Fix keyboard navigation, focus order, color-contrast issues, chart alt-text/table fallbacks, and screen-reader labels. Add automated accessibility checks to CI. Done when an accessibility scan shows no critical issues and keyboard-only navigation reaches every control.

tasks.name: Run user acceptance testing and KPI sign-off
tasks.details: Run scripted UAT sessions with each stakeholder group against the staging dashboard, validating metric definitions and workflows against the agreed KPI sheet. Log defects with severity, triage them into follow-up tasks, and capture formal sign-off per KPI. Done when every KPI is signed off or explicitly deferred with a documented reason.
